name: Nested personal install
objective: Let one engineer run this workspace privately inside a host repo they don't own, with no team-visible footprint. The engine and state live in a nested git repo at /workflow, hidden by .git/info/exclude. Skills and executors go into the host's .claude/ as untracked files, with clashing names detected and prefixed at install. Personal settings go in settings.local.json and the contract pointer in CLAUDE.local.md. Nothing is written to CI, .gitattributes or docs/. Slice commits split in two: product code to the host repo in its recorded commit convention (asked once at install), state to /workflow. phase-scope reads the host repo's base commit. Parallel worktrees are off in nested mode. Contract and skill paths carry the /workflow prefix, and an --update path covers nested installs. The acceptance walkthrough waits for a run in the real company repo.

acceptance.note: operator (2026-10-07): the review walks a fake host repo itself and passes without a stop; the operator reports real-repo problems later as fix work
